identificationModule.briefTitle: HD17 for Intermediate Stage Hodgkin Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: HD17 for Intermediate Stages - Treatment Optimization Trial in the First-Line Treatment of Intermediate Stage Hodgkin Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is designed to test the non-inferiority of the experimental arm compared to the standard arm in terms of progression free survival (PFS).

armGroups.label: Arm A
armGroups.description: 2 cycles BEACOPPescalated plus 2 cycles ABVD followed by 30Gy IF-RT irrespective of FDG-PET results after chemotherapy
interventionNames: Drug: BEACOPPescalated (Bleomycin, Etoposide, Adriamycin, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Procarbazine, Prednisone)

armGroups.label: Arm B
armGroups.description: 2 cycles BEACOPPescalated plus 2 cycles ABVD followed by 30Gy IN-RT if FDG-PET is positive after chemotherapy; 2 cycles BEACOPPescalated plus 2 cycles ABVD and treatment stop if FDG-PET is negative after chemotherapy
interventionNames: Drug: BEACOPPescalated (Bleomycin, Etoposide, Adriamycin, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Procarbazine, Prednisone)

interventions.name: BEACOPPescalated (Bleomycin, Etoposide, Adriamycin, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Procarbazine, Prednisone)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Rate of patients achieving a complete remission (CR/CRu) at final restaging after completion of study treatment

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hodgkin Lymphoma
* CS I, II with risk factor (stage IIB with risk factor 1 or 2 are not included)
* large mediastinal mass (\>1/3 of maximum transverse thorax diameter)
* extranodal involvement
* elevated ESR
* 3 or more involved nodal areas
* written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Leucocytes \<3000/µl
* Platelets \< 100000/µl
* Hodgkin Lymphoma as composite lymphoma
* Activity Index (WHO) \>2

locations.facility: 1st Dept. of Medicine, Cologne University Hospital
